sentiment_evidence: Perfect, that's exactly my list. Thank you so much Riya.

issues.title: Thank-you page redirect
issues.problem_statement: After checkout, the customer's customers landed on the default page instead of the customer's own thank-you page.

issues.title: Overlapping buttons on mobile landing page
issues.problem_statement: On a phone, the two buttons on the customer's landing page overlap each other.

issues.title: Emails going to spam
issues.problem_statement: The customer's emails are going to spam and they read that they need to verify their email domain.

issues.title: EARLYBIRD coupon expired
issues.problem_statement: The customer's EARLYBIRD coupon has expired and they are not sure whether they want to extend it.

issues.title: Invoice GST name
issues.problem_statement: The GST name on the customer's invoices shows their personal name, not their company name.

issues.title: Weekly lesson unlock for students
issues.problem_statement: The customer wants lessons to unlock one per week for their students, and sells the course inside a bundle.

issues.title: AI quiz generator
issues.problem_statement: The customer asked whether FlexiFunnels has an AI quiz generator.

issues.title: Exporting the student list
issues.problem_statement: The customer asked how to export their student list.

items.description: Customer pasted their thank-you page link into the empty redirect field in the product's After purchase settings and saved it, following support's guidance, and confirmed a test order now goes to their thank-you page.
evidence: Pasted and saved. Let me do a test order... yes, it now goes to my thank-you page.

items.description: Customer increased the spacing between the two buttons in the mobile view of the page editor, following support's guidance, and confirmed on their phone that the buttons are now separate.
evidence: Okay I increased the spacing. Let me check on my phone... yes, now they are separate, it looks fine.

items.description: Support explained that in Email settings the customer adds their domain, gets three DNS records, adds those records at their domain registrar and then clicks Verify.
evidence: In Email settings, add your domain and you will get three DNS records.

items.description: Customer will get their developer, who has the registrar login, to add the three DNS records, and then click Verify in the email settings.
evidence: I'll get him to add the records by Friday.
Once the records are added, click Verify in the email settings.

items.description: Support explained that, if the customer decides to extend the expired EARLYBIRD coupon, the expiry date can be changed in the coupon settings; the customer said they will think about whether to extend it.
evidence: If you decide to extend it, you can change the expiry date in the coupon settings.

items.description: Support will check with the billing team about changing the GST name on the invoices from the customer's personal name to their company name and get back to the customer.
evidence: I'll check with our billing team about changing it, and get back to you within 2 working days.

items.description: Support said there is a drip schedule setting for lessons but that it was not sure whether it works when the course is sold inside a bundle.
evidence: There is a drip schedule setting for lessons.
I'm not sure whether it works when the course is sold inside a bundle

items.description: Support will check with the product team whether the drip schedule works for a course sold inside a bundle and get back to the customer.
evidence: Let me check that with our product team and get back to you.

items.description: Support said it is not aware of a quiz generator being available right now, has no date for one, and advised the customer not to plan around it.
evidence: I'm not aware of a quiz generator being available right now, and I don't have a date for one.

items.description: Support explained that the student list can be exported by going to Students, clicking Export and choosing CSV, which downloads a file that opens in a spreadsheet.
evidence: Go to Students, click Export, and choose CSV.

items.description: Customer will try exporting their student list.
evidence: Got it, thanks. I'll try it later.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with many clear outcomes.
